make_video.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A painted cosmic sunset over a sea of clouds: the towering column of nebula smoke in electric cyan, violet, hot magenta and fiery orange churns and billows slowly upward out of the blazing golden sunburst on the horizon, its charcoal-black storm-cloud edges curling outward, while thin glowing pink meteors streak diagonally down from the upper left one after another and the small dark planet with a cyan rim drifts slightly across the starfield. Below, the teal clouds roll slowly toward the camera and the orange reflection ripples and shimmers in the still pools of water. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the sunburst.
overall_soundscape: A deep low wind hum sweeps across the cloud sea, soft airy whooshes and faint crackles follow each passing meteor, and a slow rumble swells from the churning nebula.
non_diegetic_music: Slow synth pads over a soft sub-bass drone with a sparse high bell arpeggio at about 70 BPM, gradually rising in volume toward the end.
make_video.name: cosmic_sky_vid_v1
